data.text: Now I'll write a SQL query to calculate the average payment value of boleto payments, filtering out canceled and unavailable orders as per the business glossary.

args.purpose: Calculate average payment value for boleto payments on non-canceled orders
args.sql:
SELECT 
  AVG(op.payment_value) as avg_boleto_payment,
  SUM(op.payment_value) as total_boleto_payments,
  COUNT(DISTINCT op.order_id) as num_orders_with_boleto
FROM order_payments op
JOIN orders o ON op.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE op.payment_type = 'boleto'
  AND o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
